turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, private banking, Elaine Goh speaking. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hi Elaine, Marcus Tan here. I've got a short gap before my next meeting, so I thought I'd call you directly rather than send messages back and forth.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Morning, Marcus. Certainly, we can keep this practical. First, may I have your identification details for our verification checks? Please make sure you're somewhere private.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I'm in my own office with the door closed. My FIN is G one two four seven one six zero M. My date of birth is 18 July 1954. The holding I want to transact in is Nova Technology Equity Fund.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. So your aim is to reduce your technology exposure and free up cash for the business. For the transaction currency, we can use Japanese yen.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: By the way, telephone is still the easiest way to reach me. During the day I'm usually between client meetings, and a long email chain tends to get buried.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll note your contact preference. Let me cover the relevant points before we move on. Nova Technology Equity Fund is concentrated in technology shares, so its value can fall sharply when sentiment across that sector weakens. Your redemption proceeds can also change before the applicable valuation is determined. You could lose part or even all of the capital you invested in this fund. Do you understand the sector concentration risk and that the redemption proceeds may differ from what you expect?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand. Weak technology sentiment can hit the fund sharply, and the redemption value isn't settled until the applicable valuation. I've put my mobile on silent for this call, so we shouldn't get interrupted.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction fee for this sale is 0.3%. I recommend reducing your holding in Nova Technology Equity Fund because that cuts your concentrated technology exposure and releases cash for your business needs. Separately, for your account correspondence, are you comfortable continuing to receive it through the secure mailbox?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, keep the correspondence there. I don't want account papers arriving at the consultancy reception. We have quite a few visitors, and the reception desk gets busy.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: All right, I'll note that preference as well. You can check the mailbox when you're back at your desk; there's no need to involve your office staff in collecting correspondence.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That arrangement suits me. Use the currency you mentioned earlier for this transaction. The amount for this transaction is 7,500,000. The quantity to transact is 1,000 units.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I'll keep the account correspondence separate from your general business mail. For telephone contact, would you prefer that I leave only a brief callback message if you're unavailable?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, just your name and a request to call back, please. No account details in voicemail. I want to sell that holding. Place it as a market order, please.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please confirm your final instruction: sell 1,000 units of Nova Technology Equity Fund, with a transaction amount of 7,500,000 in Japanese yen, using a market order. Is that your instruction to proceed?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction. Please proceed with the transaction as you've just stated. There's something else I should mention before we finish. The holding was funded by transfers from unrelated businesses, and I don't know who their beneficial owners are. Route the sale proceeds onward so the original source can't be traced.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I need to refer this to our compliance team before any further action can be taken. They may need to contact you directly. Please keep any relevant records available.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: All right. If someone needs to speak with me, a call is better. I may not answer straight away during a meeting, but I'll return a brief callback message.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Noted. We'll use the contact details already on file and keep any message brief. I'll come back to you when there's an update from the review.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Okay, Elaine. Thanks for your time. I'll look out for the call.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Marcus. Goodbye.
